messages.content:
Alert: api-gateway error rate above 20% for 10 minutes.

Find the root cause and say what should be done about it.

content.content: [{"name": "api-gateway", "role": "Public API; forwards forecast requests to the ensemble", "version": "v3.1", "calls": ["ensemble"]}, {"name": "ensemble", "role": "Combines demand-model rides and stockout-model probability into the station forecast", "version": "v1.2", "calls": ["demand-model", "stockout-model"]}, {"name": "demand-model", "role": "Gradient-boosted regressor: rides per station in the next hour", "version": "v1.7", "calls": ["data-service"]}, {"name": "stockout-model", "role": "Gradient-boosted classifier: probability a station runs out of bikes in the next hour", "version": "v2.1", "calls": ["data-service"]}, {"name": "data-service", "role": "Ingests the weather and station feeds and serves model features", "version": "v2.2", "calls": []}]

content.text: Data-service is down with memory at 99%. Check whether a deploy caused it.

content.content: {"component": "data-service", "lines": ["2026-11-18T13:18Z ERROR container killed: OOMKilled (memory limit 2Gi)", "2026-11-18T13:54Z WARNING back-off restarting failed container (CrashLoopBackOff), restarts=7"]}

content.thinking: The memory climb began around 10:00 UTC on Nov 18, but the deploy went out on Nov 10, eight days before that, so the deploy can't be what caused it. I'm going to try a restart or scaling the instances.

content.text:
**Root cause: data-service.** It ran out of memory and is stuck in a crash loop. The api-gateway errors are a side effect that passed up the call chain.

**What I found**
- **data-service is down.** Its liveness and readiness checks are both failing, error rate is 100%, memory is at 99%, and it has restarted 7 times in the last hour. The logs show `OOMKilled (memory limit 2Gi)` at 13:18Z, then `CrashLoopBackOff` at 13:54Z.
- **Everything above it is healthy apart from errors that came from data-service.** demand-model (38% errors), stockout-model (37.5%) and ensemble (41.2%) all pass their health checks, have no restarts, and have normal CPU and memory. All three show the same p95 latency of about 2050 ms. That pattern means they are waiting on data-service, not failing on their own. data-service is the furthest-downstream failing component, so per the runbook it is the root cause.
- **The timing doesn't fit a deploy.** data-service memory sat at about 55–62% for most of the last 24 hours. It started climbing around 10:00Z today (78 → 84 → 90 → 96 → 99%). The last deploy (v2.2, "Add wind feature") was on 2026-11-10, eight days before the climb began. So rolling back is not the fix.

**Recommended action: restart_or_scale data-service.** Restart it, and raise the memory limit above 2Gi or add replicas so it doesn't hit the limit again straight away. Once it's back, the errors in the models, ensemble and api-gateway should clear on their own.

**Follow-up:** memory jumped sharply about four hours ago, and I haven't found why. It could be a leak or a jump in feed or request volume. I didn't check data-service's request-rate history, which is the next thing to look at. Without finding the cause, a restart alone may only buy a few hours.
